name: ENKRATEIA
source:
How far would you go to follow the love of your life? A town over? across state lines? to the other side of the country? Further? What are you willing to give up? She loves you. It needs to stop.

ENKRATEIA is about two women waiting for the right moment. ENKRATEIA is about being pushed to your breaking point. ENKRATEIA is about not forgiving her. 

You still have time to fix this. 

[From [url=https://gayloser.itch.io/enkrateia]itch.io[/url]]
